Use [`gmeow:addressHolder`](gmeow-addressHolder.md) from [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AddressTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent who held a contact point over a [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AddressTenure.md)'s interval.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one holder per tenure (it is functional) and avoid using it for the channel itself (that is [`gmeow:tenuredContactPoint`](gmeow-tenuredContactPoint.md)).

### How to use

- Point the tenure at its single [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); pair with [`gmeow:tenuredContactPoint`](gmeow-tenuredContactPoint.md) and the time-scoped interval to complete the situation.
